items.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.answer: We typically cater to corporate orders starting from 25 hampers, with flexible options based on your requirements.

items.question: Can we customise the packaging?
items.answer: Yes. We offer logo printing, personalised greeting cards, branded sleeves and fully customised gift boxes.

items.question: Do you deliver across India?
items.answer: Yes. We provide safe and timely delivery to offices, homes and multiple locations nationwide.

items.question: Can we request product samples?
items.answer: Absolutely. Sample hampers are available before placing large corporate orders.
